reviews.review:
Absolutely amazing game, aesthetically pleasing dark and grimey atmosphere. Was my second souls-like ive ever played and ive got to admit, do not go with the lowest difficulty. Many of the reviews on steam and reddit spooked me into choosing it. Do not do it. The game is way too easy. Only bosses i had 10 or more deaths on were the final boss alongside with The Labyrinth Sentinel (latter being due to impatience). Rest of the bosses were either no deaths or 1-2. Later switched to nightmare for my second run of the campaign, still way too easy. Highly recommend apocalypse.
Overall HIGHLY recommended to anyone that enjoys kicking some monster ass.
9/10

A fantastic sequel to a great original game. Improves upon the first in a multitude of ways. Plays very similarly to the first, so if you weren't a fan of it I can't be sure the sequel will change your mind. If you liked the first, then the second will be an excellent upgrade from it, with tons of items to collect, secrets to find, and classes to try. Being able to use perks from two classes is cool and opens up a lot of build variety. Overall, I highly recommend this game and definitely think the complete edition was worth it for me. If you aren't huge on replaying games, then you probably don't need it, but this game begs to be played through a few times at least.

Remnant 2 is a game for very specific type of player. The same could be said about R1, but for R2 the developers doubled-down on things that narrowed the appeal of the game, like obscure requirements for obtaining new items / classes, and did very little to make you care about progressing through the game - the lore and story is barebones, the biome variety is very poor and player power level barely changes. Disappointing.

Let us get one thing straight, I really like this game, it is one of my favourite games. I loved it compared to From the Ashes substantially more in almost every regard regard. Love the gunplay, *Loved* The build crafting, Exploration with grind, the sceneries (Besides Yaesha mostly, except DLC). My problems lay in two things: 

PC performance after release of the DLCs
And the constant nerfing of what they deemed too powerful.

Now I get nerfing some of the more ♥♥♥♥♥♥ up things that allowed Destroying the game like pressing on a toddlers skull, but a lot of what they did was hardly *Broken*. Rather than amping difficulty they lowered us, while also increasing the enemy ratio.

PC performance is my MAJOR grievance, ESPECIALLY on N'Erud DLC, which if it weren't for that I would have thoroughly enjoyed the entire experience. But even outside the DLC, these new updates ruined most of the games performance. thus my enjoyment.

One thing I will say is that people hate the DLCs too much, they are pretty good I like the in order The Awakened King -> The Dark Horizon -> The Forgotten Kingdom. Now it may not be as good as From the Ashes DLCs, but that was a different game basically, and what we got here is more than enough for me.

Just the issues is what ruins this for me, I really like this game, but its Developers doesn't seem to like us.
Its Dark Souls with guns what's not to like?
